title: ToneMamaba: Learning Contextualized Tonal Contours with Boundary-Reset State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mandarin tone recognition in connected speech is challenging because contextual and durational variation reshapes F0 contours. We propose ToneMamba, a boundary-aware state space model that replaces static boundary embeddings with bidirectional state resets at syllable, word, and IPU levels. Fixed weights fuse multi-level representations, while shared-weight bidirectional scans use channel-wise directional fusion to reduce parameters. Dynamic syllable pooling forms tonal contours, and rhythm-conditioned gating incorporates durational information. ToneMamba achieves 97.9% and 74.8% accuracy on FCU-VOICE-360 read and MCDC-8 conversational speech, outperforming the baseline (ToneNet) by 0.9 and 15.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that word-level resets are particularly effective, while rhythm conditioning provides greater gains in conversational speech, underscoring the role of durational variation in spontaneous speech.

translated_title: ToneMamba：基于边界重置状态空间模型学习上下文相关的声调轮廓
translated_abstract: 连续语流中的普通话声调识别极具挑战性，因为语境和时长的变化会重塑基音频率（F0）轮廓。我们提出ToneMamba，这是一种边界感知的状态空间模型，它在音节、词和话语单元（IPU）三个层面用双向状态重置取代静态边界嵌入。模型采用固定权重融合多层次表征，并通过共享权重的双向扫描结合逐通道方向融合来减少参数量。动态音节池化用于构建声调轮廓，节奏条件门控则引入时长信息。ToneMamba在FCU-VOICE-360朗读语音和MCDC-8会话语音上分别达到97.9%和74.8%的准确率，分别超越基线模型ToneNet 0.9和15.9个百分点。消融实验表明，词级重置尤为有效，而节奏条件化在会话语音中带来更大收益，凸显了时长变化在自然口语中的重要作用。
tldr: ToneMamba通过在音节、词和话语单元层面进行双向状态重置的边界感知状态空间模型，结合节奏条件门控建模时长信息，显著提升了普通话声调识别性能，在会话语音上提升尤为突出。
en_tdlr: ToneMamba, a boundary-aware state space model with bidirectional state resets at syllable, word, and IPU levels plus rhythm-conditioned gating for duration modeling, substantially improves Mandarin tone recognition, with especially large gains in conversational speech.
